items.text: Want to boost your operations? Get in touch with us!

Goods handling in intralogistics is changing rapidly. Volumes and requirements are increasing, and processes are becoming more complex. The shortage of skilled workers is adding to this pressure. Companies therefore need to organize their material and goods flows in a flexible, efficient, and reliable way, while keeping an eye on their costs. There is a growing demand for intralogistics solutions that can be seamlessly integrated into value chains and adapted to changing conditions.
This is exactly where Linde Material Handling comes in.

With the digitalization and automation of intralogistics—using software-controlled guided vehicles, conveyor technology, and storage systems, with intelligent warehouse management to optimize all goods flows and processes. System solutions that increase efficiency, reduce costs, minimize errors and are tailored to the individual requirements of your company—

Looking Ahead: Robot Automates Order Picking

With the Robotic Case Picker (RoCaP), Linde MH is solving one of the biggest challenges in intralogistics: the automation of order picking. The autonomous vehicle combines artificial intelligence with sophisticated camera and gripping technology to independently perform complex palletizing and depalletizing processes in mixed operation. Initial successful practical tests at ROSSMANN mark the beginning of a new era in warehouse automation.

Linde Material Handling provides everything you need to optimize your intralogistics and successfully automate your processes. We provide everything from a single source, with competent, holistic design. Our services form the basis for efficient, customized solutions. We support you throughout the process, from planning to commissioning, whether you are constructing new premises or upgrading existing ones. Our comprehensive guarantees the availability and performance of your systems. Flexible ensures that your investment remains easy to plan and economical.

Based on your objectives and current processes, we work with you to develop the optimal target state for your intralogistics. We use existing data and, if necessary, collect our own data on site to record and analyze all and requirements along the handling processes. This enables us to determine the individual optimization and automation potential for your operational processes.

Based on an analysis of the current situation and your objectives, we develop a concept that combines material flow planning, fleet optimization, warehouse layout, and suitable automation components. Simulation and visualization help to verify the optimal future setup. Transparent cost and implementation planning with a view to ROI and TCO shows when your investment will pay off and what added value it will create in the long term.

Whether you are planning a completely new facility or want to modernize your existing infrastructure, as a general contractor, we accompany you right up to the handover of the turnkey facility. Plus, in transparent coordination with your internal project management team, we ensure the precise implementation of each process step—from the first shelf to testing and commissioning of the entire system solution.
A designated contact person is available throughout the entire project to coordinate all involved parties and maintain an overview. This ensures that all work steps mesh seamlessly.

To ensure smooth and safe operation of the automated systems, Linde MH trains your employees before the systems are handed over. This ensures that your team is familiar with all functions, processes, and safety aspects and can operate the new technology right from the start.

Thanks to careful planning, we consistently implement projects within the agreed time frame and budget. We also provide our customers with particularly close support during the start-up phase after commissioning. Enhanced service support ensures that operations run smoothly from day one.

Our Portfolio: the Right Solution for Every Need

Linde MH’s are as diverse as our customers’ requirements. With our extensive experience in mobile applications, a high level of expertise in automating existing systems, and well-designed solutions for new construction projects, we offer the right product selection for every need.

These include automated Linde industrial trucks ( ), autonomous mobile robots ( ), and configurable AGVs. Where high throughput and compaction are possible, we use stationary solutions, such as , container storage systems, conveyor technology, and storage and retrieval machines.
We combine this wide variety of mobile and stationary systems flexibly to create individual scenarios and cover all processes, from incoming to outgoing goods.
Autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) and automated guided vehicles (AGVs) ensure flexible and efficient handling and transport of a wide variety of goods and load carriers.
Shuttle systems, compact warehouses, automated small parts warehouses, and storage and retrieval machines enable optimal use of space and high throughput in material flow.
Modern conveyor technology, ergonomic picking stations, and racking systems from proven Linde partners round off the complete range of our automation solutions.
One-stop warehouse automation: Discover our portfolio!

Automation solutions from Linde MH can be quickly integrated, flexibly expanded, and seamlessly adapted to existing processes. You can start with just one to five vehicles. From there, you can gradually expand and adapt the system to your business’s growing automation needs, all the way to a fully automated system.

Thanks to the Linde MATIC:move control software, your automation can start with individual process steps and just a few vehicles, even without a WMS connection. With digital mapping and visualization of the routes in the control software, you can use the AGVs safely and efficiently. Your employees can easily add routes or stations themselves at any time.

Automated guided vehicles (AGVs) and autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) can be tested on site in trial operation. This allows the feasibility to be realistically assessed within a day. Once the tasks for AGVs or AMRs have been defined after successful testing and the integration of the devices into existing processes has been designed, commissioning usually takes place within three days.

Whether for new construction projects or existing facilities, all components (from mobile and stationary systems to the control software Linde MATIC:move and MATIC:move+) are optimally coordinated and can be easily integrated into existing processes and IT systems thanks to the VDA 5050 interface.

The control software Linde MATIC:move+ for Linde MH’s AGVs is flexibly scalable and can be used with our WMS , or can also be easily integrated into other higher-level warehouse management systems via the standard VDA 5050 interface. The Linde Warehouse Manager coordinates the interaction between manual and automated systems.

We are constantly expanding our product range and adapting it to new requirements. By working with technology partners and leveraging the resources of the KION Group, we can offer our customers modern, high-performance, and future-proof solutions.

Whether manual or automated, the use of software systems is a prerequisite for efficient intralogistics processes. Linde MH’s warehouse management system (WMS), , links the data flows of the supply chain with the physical processes in the warehouse. This allows all processes to be optimally controlled, monitored, and analyzed.
Learn more about the Linde Warehouse Manager!
The controls both manual and automated processes and coordinates all material flows in the warehouse, from storage and picking to shipping.
Inventories as well as incoming and outgoing goods are fully recorded and managed. All processes are clearly documented and can be traced at any time.

Interfaces can be used to connect the forklift guidance system, the integrated forklift guidance system for manual vehicles, and the control software for automated systems. Integration into the company’s ERP system is also possible.

The is VDA 5050-compatible, allowing automated guided vehicles and control software from different manufacturers to communicate with each other. The solution is compatible with all common WMS systems.

Forward Thinking: AI Innovations for the Warehouse of Tomorrow

Together with NVIDIA and Accenture, Linde Material Handling is developing AI solutions for the future of material flows. At the heart of these solutions are real-time localization of all vehicles and digital twins that create virtual warehouse images for optimal process control. AI-supported orchestration perfectly coordinates manual and automated fleets. The result is a material flow with revolutionary transparency, efficiency, and flexibility for a decisive competitive advantage.
Simon Hegele Boosts Efficiency with Warehouse Automation
What’s the best way to address the shortage of skilled workers in logistics? Simon Hegele has turned to warehouse automation from Linde MH—and it’s a real success story.

Long distances, narrow spaces, steep ramps—all combined in a busy environment with people and trucks working side by side. At the Ansbach headquarters of the German plastics specialist Oechsler AG, three Linde L-MATIC HDs ensure the consistently efficient flow of goods around the clock.

Automation made easy: This was the challenge facing TST GmbH in Düsseldorf (Germany). Armed with the expertise and technology from Linde, it was possible to overcome this challenge in a short space of time.
